speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
text: asked the Minister for Defence (a) so far, how many National Servicemen who were injured during NS have appealed to the Ministry to allow them to continue their insurance in addition to what has been granted under MediShield Life; and (b) what assistance and assurance have been given to them.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: In addition, financial assistance may be provided to injured NSmen through MINDEF's welfare schemes.
